messages.subject: DT Tables failing to render
parts:
Hi,

running the below shiny script fails to render the data table on x86_64-redhat-linux-gnu (64-bit)
running circles trying to figure out what the issue is here.

same script in windows is running perfectly. 

much appreciated!


library(shiny)
library(DT)
shinyApp(
  ui = fluidPage(DT::dataTableOutput('tbl')),
  server = function(input, output) {
    output$tbl = DT::renderDataTable({
      DT::datatable(iris, options = list(lengthChange = FALSE))
    })
  }
)

messages.author: 85e053d519f0f372
messages.subject: Re: DT Tables failing to render
parts:
At least I see your jsonlite version is 0.9.14, which is lower than
what is required:
https://github.com/ramnathv/htmlwidgets/blob/master/DESCRIPTION#L16 I
do not know how you managed to install htmlwidgets 0.3.3 anyway.

update.packages(ask = FALSE) should fix it (when in doubt, first see
if updating packages fixes the problem :).

Regards,
Yihui
